## Task

Describe the small change that a new contributor can complete without deep project context.

## Recommended Area

- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Demo data
- [ ] Local setup
- [ ] UI copy
- [ ] CSV/Excel template
- [ ] Playwright smoke test
- [ ] Accessibility or mobile layout
- [ ] TypeScript cleanup

## Context

Link the relevant route, file, or document.

- Route:
- File:
- Related docs:

## Expected Outcome

- [ ] The change is small enough for one focused pull request.
- [ ] The expected behavior is clear.
- [ ] No real customer data, production screenshots, secrets, logs, or `.env.local` are required.
- [ ] Chinese-mode customer-facing text, templates, and exports remain Chinese-first.

## Verification

Recommended checks:

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build` if code or app behavior changes
- [ ] Manual check:

## Maintainer Notes

Add any constraints that the contributor should know before starting.
